zone.generalHint: Errors and outcome rules that apply to every system of the project
zone.masksHint: {{count}} data types · only an administrator edits · on a shared link everything is hidden for any role

masking.intro: Everything hidden in the project logs in all environments. A type that is off is visible only in record detail blocks. “Card number” and “Secrets” cannot be turned off: only the eye icon opens their values. While there is no sign-in, the eye icon opens every type except these two.
masking.confirm: Turn off “{{name}}”? The values will be visible to all project users in all environments.
masking.conflict: Another user changed this record. The current state is shown, make your change again.
masking.unavailable: The catalog database is unavailable: the change was not saved. Try again later.
masking.saveFailed: The change was not saved. Try again later.
masking.sheetSubtitle: Built-in fields cannot be removed, but you can turn off the whole type.
masking.saved: Saved: the values of these fields are hidden in the next response.
masking.readers_one: Saved. {{count}} catalog record reads these fields: its values are now shown masked.
masking.readers_other: Saved. {{count}} catalog records read these fields: their values are now shown masked.
masking.fileDisables: The file turns off “{{name}}”: the values will be visible to all project users in all environments.
masking.locked: No switch: only the eye icon opens the values.
masking.sheetSubtitleLocked: This type cannot be turned off, only the eye icon opens the values. Built-in fields cannot be removed, you can add your own.
masking.note: Built-in fields are always recognized, even without the database. An added field works only while the database is available.
masking.noteSecrets: This type also hides values after Basic, Bearer and Digest, a password in an address and cookies.
masking.noteCard: This type also hides any number that passes the Luhn check in text, and Value in FilterCondition.

sectionNotFound: This section does not exist: the system may have been deleted or hidden. The “Project” section is open.
noAuthor: The project author system has not been created yet: the server creates it when it connects to the database.
partnerCodeHint: The partner will get code {{code}} per the registry

off.title: Catalog is off
off.text: Names of methods, systems and errors are stored in a PostgreSQL database. To turn the catalog on, set the database address in the THREADLINE_DATABASE_URL variable and restart Threadline (see the catalog section of config/README.md).

unavailable.title: Catalog unavailable
unavailable.text: The catalog database is not responding and no data has been loaded. Threadline keeps working with readable paths, without names.

readOnly.stale: The catalog database is unavailable: the last loaded data is shown, editing is disabled.
readOnly.error: The catalog loaded with an error, editing is disabled. {{message}}
readOnly.errorPlain: The catalog loaded with an error, editing is disabled.

search.label: Search the catalog
search.placeholder: Name, path, host, code, error text, ID type or status

empty.methods: No methods yet. Add a method or open “Unknown”: it collects what the service came across but did not recognize.
empty.outcomes: No outcome rules yet. Without them, the response outcome is decided by general error signs and error rules.

ids.intro: ID types: entities and operations. The placeholder name in a path template sets the type: {transferId} and {transfer} are both the type transfer.

unknown.intro: What the service came across in found requests but did not recognize. The most frequent is at the top.
unknown.empty: Everything found is recognized: nothing unknown.
unknown.unavailable: The list is unavailable right now: the catalog database is not responding.
unknown.hideFailed: Could not change the row: {{code}}. Refresh the page and try again.
unknown.hideForbidden: The server refused: your role does not allow changing this row.
unknown.hideUnavailable: The catalog database is unavailable: the row was not changed. Try again later.

file.forceHint: Without this flag, import leaves records edited in the editor alone and shows them as skipped. With the flag, they are replaced by the version from the file.
file.hasErrors_one: The file has {{count}} error, nothing was applied
file.hasErrors_other: The file has {{count}} errors, nothing was applied
file.willChange_one: Check without writing: import will change {{count}} record
file.willChange_other: Check without writing: import will change {{count}} records
file.skippedHint: The skipped records were edited in the editor. To replace them with the version from the file, turn on “Replace manual edits” and check again.
file.undeletedHint: The file does not bring back records deleted in the editor. To restore them, turn on “Replace manual edits” and check again.

group.undeleted: Deleted records the file does not bring back

form.gone: This record no longer exists: it was deleted or hidden.
form.readOnly: The catalog database is unavailable: editing is disabled.
form.readOnlyRole: Read only: your role cannot edit records of this kind.
form.forbidden: The server refused: your role does not allow this action. What you entered is still in the form.
form.conflict: The record was changed while you were editing it.
form.deleted: The record no longer exists: it was deleted while you were editing it. You can create it again from the form.
form.duplicateHidden: This record already exists but has been deleted. You can restore it instead of creating a new one: what you entered stays in the form until you press “Restore”.
form.inUse_one: The type is used in {{count}} method: it cannot be deleted or hidden.
form.inUse_other: The type is used in {{count}} methods: it cannot be deleted or hidden.
form.inUseUnknown: The type is used in methods: it cannot be deleted or hidden.
form.author: The project author system cannot be deleted, but it can be renamed.
form.unavailable: The catalog database is unavailable: the record was not saved. What you entered is still in the form.
form.off: The catalog is off: the record was not saved.
form.invalid: Check the form fields: the server rejected the record.
form.failed: Could not save the record ({{code}}). What you entered is still in the form.
form.deleteConfirm: The record will be hidden and stop taking part in matching. You can restore it with the “Hidden” filter.
form.deleteWithDeps: The record will be hidden together with dependent records: {{list}}. They stop taking part in matching and come back together with it. You can restore it with the “Hidden” filter.
form.foreverConfirm: Delete the record permanently? This cannot be undone.
form.foreverWithDeps: Delete permanently together with dependent records: {{list}}? This cannot be undone.
form.notHidden: Only a hidden record can be deleted permanently, and this one is no longer hidden.
form.restoredUnderHidden: The record is restored. It starts working once “{{name}}” is restored.
form.hideConfirm: This record came from the initial set: it will be hidden and stop taking part in matching. You can restore it with the “Hidden” filter.
form.hostChoice: Host {{host}} is not recognized. Where should it be added?
form.noSystemScope: The system of this step is not described, so the record goes to General rules. They apply across the project where there is no more precise record. A record on another system will not change this step.
form.hostExisting: Add the host to an existing system

hint.systemKey: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters: billing, card-gateway.
hint.keyFixed: The key cannot change after creation.
hint.hosts: One per line: host, host:port, [ipv6]:port or *.domain. A host belongs to one system only.
hint.path: Starts with “/”, a {name} placeholder takes the whole part of the path between “/”, no “?” or “#”.
hint.rpc: The first Body element in SOAP without a prefix, or method in JSON-RPC.
hint.opTypes: The list shows the operation types of this project. They are added in the section
hint.noOpTypes: This project has no operation types yet. Add a type of kind “Operation” in the section
hint.idFields: An ID outside the path: a query string parameter or a body field. IDs with a type link the requests of one operation together.
hint.idTypes: The list shows the ID types of this project. They are added in the section
hint.noIdTypes: This project has no ID types yet. Add a type in the section
hint.statusNeedsOp: Only a method with an operation type has a status field.
hint.statusMap: Maps record values to statuses of the “{{type}}” dictionary, case-insensitive. Dictionary values work without mapping too.
hint.code: Codes made of digits are compared as numbers: “00” and “0” are the same code.
hint.textMatch: From 3 characters. Case, extra spaces and line breaks do not matter.
hint.action: Hint for second-line support: what to check and whom to contact.
hint.severityOk: “Not an error”: the step is not red and the request does not count as an error.
hint.partnerCode: The project code that the partner will get per the registry.
hint.priority: Within a level, a lower priority is checked first; method rules come before system and project rules.
hint.fieldPath: JSON: names separated by dots (data.status). XML: the element name. The “equals” check is case-insensitive.
hint.template: {path} inserts a response field value, for example {message}. Up to 5 placeholders.
hint.typeKey: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and “_”, starting with a letter: payment, merchant_payment.
hint.typeUsed_one: The type is used in {{count}} method: it cannot be deleted or hidden.
hint.typeUsed_other: The type is used in {{count}} methods: it cannot be deleted or hidden.
hint.statuses: In the order of the operation life cycle: value, name and outcome. The order sets the place of the status on the operation timeline.

validation.pathTooLong: Field path no longer than {{max}} characters
validation.masked: Remove the card number or secret: masking would hide part of the text
validation.httpRange: HTTP status is a number from 100 to 599
validation.httpOrder: The start of the range is greater than the end
validation.httpList: Comma-separated numbers from 100 to 599 or ranges like 400-499
validation.noConditions: At least one condition is needed: HTTP status or field
validation.noErrorConditions: At least one condition is needed: HTTP status, code or substring
validation.generalHttpOnly: One HTTP status is not enough for general rules: every such error in the project would get this text. Enter a text substring or a code
validation.textHidden: The substring has a hidden part, “…” or asterisks: the error text does not have it, so the record will not match. Keep only the constant part
validation.pathQuery: No query string: “?” and “#” are not allowed in a template
validation.pathPlaceholder: A {name} placeholder takes the whole part of the path between “/”: /cards/{cardId}, not /cards/id{cardId}
validation.pathEmptySegment: Empty part of the path: two “/” in a row
validation.keySystem: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters
validation.keyType: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and “_”, starting with a letter, up to 32 characters
validation.hostFormat: Invalid host template {{name}}: host, host:port, [ipv6]:port or *.domain
validation.hostTaken: The host already belongs to system “{{name}}”
validation.opRequired: This method kind needs an operation type
validation.opNotOperation: A type of kind “operation” is needed, but this one is an entity
validation.unknownType: This type does not exist: add it in “IDs” first
validation.statusNotInType: This status is not in the type dictionary
validation.valueDuplicate: This status is already in the dictionary
validation.priorityRange: Priority is a number from 1 to 1000
validation.templateUnclosed: Unclosed “{”: a placeholder is written as {path}
validation.templatePlace: Path in a placeholder: Latin letters, digits, “_”, “.”, “:” and “-”
validation.sensitive: This field is masked: a card number, secret or authorization header cannot be shown or compared
validation.templateSensitive: The template has a masked field: a card number, secret or authorization header

fileDraft.leave: Your project file edits are not applied and will be lost. Leave the page?
fileDraft.kept: Your project file text with edits is safe: it comes back with the page, and you can download it meanwhile.
fileDraft.chunkTitle: The file editor did not load
fileDraft.chunkText: The page code did not load, for example the service was just updated. Try loading again.
fileDraft.hiddenTitle: There is no project file yet
fileDraft.hiddenText: The project is hidden or its record failed validation. Open “General”: it shows the reason and lets you bring the project back.
